text:
when you are young

a pair

of women's

high-heeled

shoes

motionless

solitary

in the closet

can ignite

your bones;

when you are old

they are only

a pair of shoes

with

nobody

in them

and

nothing more.

translation.title: When You Are Young...
translation.editorial_note: The translation preserves the contrast between erotic charge in youth and emptied object in age.
